title: Hiring Panel provenance audit (the Skeptic's second mode)
description: work/rewrite/provenance.json. One item per audited bullet of work/rewrite/resume.json. Every bullet with a NEW_WORDING warning in truth.json must appear. See references/provenance-audit.md.

mode.description: subagent = a fresh Skeptic subagent (Claude Code); self = the main conversation audited its own rewrite (disclosed in the report)

bullet_id.description: the bullet's id in resume.json, or 'basics.headline' for the headline

audited_text.description: the bullet text exactly as it was in resume.json when audited

problem.description: one neutral sentence: which words go beyond which sources; null when ok

suggested_text.description: soften only: a version built only from the cited sources; null otherwise
